part.text:
The robot followed the corridor to its end and stopped about 0.75 m in front of the green panel. I then called rest, and the robot is now crouched with its motors off. The last camera image still shows the green panel filling the view.

The corridor turned left twice, and the green panel was at the end of the last stretch.
